children: State Street’s Consumer Staples Select Sector SPDR ETF

fell around 3% in the September quarter, pressured by surging oil prices, a shift toward risk-on tech/AI stocks, hotter inflation data that reduced rate-cut hopes, and margin concerns at major holdings such as Walmart

, Seeking Alpha analyst, said that Q3 further shows the growing divergence within consumer staples, with investors rewarding companies that can demonstrate either strong execution or a compelling value proposition while punishing businesses facing weaker demand and margin pressure. He continues to favor discount and off-price retailers such as Dollar General
, Dollar Tree
, Ross Stores
, Burlington Stores
, and TJX Companies
in this environment, as persistent inflation could keep consumers focused on value even as broader staples performance remains uneven.
Consumer staples sector Q3 scorecard
Sector Return: -2.97%
Best Performer: Target (+21.1%)

Top consumer staples performers of the month
On the individual stock front, Target
and Philip Morris International
were among the top five gainers, as investors continued to favor discount retailers benefiting from value-conscious consumer spending.
Estée Lauder
gained 6.5% during the quarter, with a 16% jump following its earnings release helping offset weakness in its personal care business.
